function: CSI feedback and compression with twin LSTM channel predictors at UE and gNB; the UE feeds back the quantized prediction error (p. 4, 6).
system: Downlink massive MIMO, 64 gNB transmit antennas, 1 UE receive antenna, OFDM (10 MHz LTE numerology, 600 subcarriers), 2.18 GHz carrier, no RIS (p. 7-8, Table I).
method: Supervised LSTM channel predictor (two hidden layers, 200 neurons, MSE loss, Adam) trained at the UE on uncompressed CSI, model then reported to the gNB (p. 4-6, 8).
data_channel: Measurements at Nokia Bell-Labs campus, Stuttgart (track-1 train; tracks 2, 6 test) and MATLAB nrCDLChannel 3GPP CDL dataset of 15k samples for the CsiNet comparison (p. 7-8, 10).
test_conditions: Trained on 80% of track-1 (10% validation); tested on the rest of track-1 and on 10% of track-2 and track-6, 'away from the trained track' (p. 7-9).
baselines: Conventional quantized CSI feedback (non-learned), MLaBE two-sided ML predictor trained on compressed CSI [46], and the CsiNet autoencoder [9], pre-trained and retrained (p. 9-10, Table II).
metrics: NMSE, precoding gain (matched-filter precoder), cosine similarity, and RMSE in the dataset-size study, versus feedback bits B_Q (p. 7-8, 10).
complexity: 8.4 M FLOPs per prediction versus 58.52 M for CsiNet; complexity formulas for multiplications and parameters; training took 52 minutes on a laptop (p. 11).

notes: Included, area 2 (CSI feedback and prediction). q1: trained and tested on measured data (p. 7), plus 3GPP CDL via nrCDLChannel (p. 10). q2: trained on track-1, tested on track-2 and track-6 of the same campus campaign (p. 8-9); different tracks, not a different site, so the reviewer should confirm. q3: non-learned conventional feedback and learned CsiNet [9] compared on NMSE, precoding gain and cosine similarity (Table II, p. 10). q4: 8.4 M FLOPs versus 58.52 M for CsiNet, plus complexity expressions (p. 11). q5 rests only on the measured-data route of the rule: the paper gives no link, code or data release, and refers to [51] for campaign details (p. 7); the reviewer should confirm. Other facts: channel estimation assumed perfect (p. 4), single UE (p. 3 footnote), single subcarrier used (p. 8). Table II cites MLaBE and CsiNet as [47] and [57], the text as [46] and [56].
